description: Access directory status, access point health, manual pinning, manifest refresh, recovery links and access events.

fields.name: accessPointId
fields.description: The pinned access point.

fields.name: expiresAtMs
fields.description: When the pin lapses, Unix milliseconds; an app restart also clears it.

models.name: AccessPinRequest
models.description: Pins one access point of the home cell.

fields.name: accessPointId
fields.description: Access point to pin, as listed by access.listAccessPoints.

models.name: AccessConnectAck
models.description: Diagnostics the gateway returned in CONNECT_ACK for the current connection; shown only, nothing acts on them.

fields.name: gatewayId
fields.description: Gateway instance serving the connection.

fields.name: accessPointId
fields.description: Access point the server reports for the connection, when its gateway is configured with one.

fields.name: accessSerial
fields.description: Newest access manifest serial the server knows.

fields.name: heartbeatIntervalHintSec
fields.description: Gateway heartbeat interval in seconds; the heartbeat itself follows the access policy.

fields.name: accessPointMismatch
fields.description: The server reports a different access point than the client chose; logged and counted, the connection stays up.

models.name: AccessStatus
models.description: Access directory and current link summary for the diagnostics page.

fields.name: loaded
fields.description: Whether the directory holds a usable manifest. False means there is no access point to connect to until bootstrap or a recovery link brings one.

fields.name: serial
fields.description: Serial of the loaded access manifest; 0 before loading.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the manifest came from: seed, https:<mirror base>, wellKnown:<apId>, recovery, development, or none when the directory is empty. A restart keeps the original source.

fields.name: stale
fields.description: Whether the manifest is past expiresAtMs: it still connects, and refresh retries every 10 minutes.

fields.name: developmentMode
fields.description: Endpoints come from development-mode configuration.

fields.name: issuedAtMs
fields.description: When the manifest was issued, Unix milliseconds; absent with an empty directory.

fields.name: expiresAtMs
fields.description: When the manifest expires, Unix milliseconds; absent with an empty directory.

fields.name: fetchedAtMs
fields.description: When the manifest reached this device, Unix milliseconds; absent for a seed or development mode.

fields.name: regionId
fields.description: Home region.

fields.name: cellId
fields.description: Home cell.

fields.name: keystateSerial
fields.description: Serial of the loaded signing key state.

fields.name: accessPointId
fields.description: Access point the IM connection is on.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Transport of the IM connection: quic or ws.

fields.name: pinned
fields.description: The manual pin, when one is in force.

fields.name: connectAck
fields.description: CONNECT_ACK diagnostics of the current connection; absent without one.

fields.name: refresh
fields.description: Manifest refresh progress; absent in development mode.

fields.name: recovering
fields.description: Present only while every access point has failed and recovery is running.

models.name: AccessRefreshStatus
models.description: Progress of the periodic manifest refresh.

fields.name: lastAttemptAtMs
fields.description: When the last round ran, Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: lastSuccessAtMs
fields.description: When a source last gave a trusted answer, Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: lastOutcome
fields.description: Outcome of the last round: adopted, upToDate, oldValues or failed; absent before the first round.

fields.name: nextAtMs
fields.description: When the next round runs, Unix milliseconds; absent while recovering without a network.

models.name: AccessRecoveringStatus
models.description: Recovery state while every access point has failed.

fields.name: sinceMs
fields.description: When recovery began, Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: rounds
fields.description: Bootstrap rounds run so far.

fields.name: nextRoundAtMs
fields.description: When the next round runs, Unix milliseconds; absent while the device has no network.

models.name: AccessRefreshAttempt
models.description: One source tried during a refresh round. Sources the round never reached are not listed.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The source: https:<base>, wellKnown:<apId> or doh:<resolver>.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Tier: mirror, wellKnown, pointer (a mirror resolved through DoH) or resolver (the DoH resolver itself).

fields.name: document
fields.description: Document fetched: access, keys or pointer.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Result: adopted, notModified, sameSerial, olderSerial, rejected, failed or resolved.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable cross-platform code of a rejection or failure: badSignature, rollback, keyCert.expired, revoked, wrongPayloadType, wrongBootstrapId, tooLarge, malformedEnvelope, invalidPayload, unknownKey, unsupportedSchema, noNetwork, unreachable, tls, timeout, cancelled or http.<status>.

fields.name: serial
fields.description: Serial of the document, when one was read.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: adopted (a new manifest was taken), upToDate (a source confirmed there is no update), oldValues (notified mode only got old values; a manual refresh never reports it), failed (no source gave a trusted answer) or skipped (development mode).

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Round mode: background, notified or recovering.

fields.name: serial
fields.description: Directory serial when the round ended.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Source of the adopted manifest, in the form of AccessStatus.source; absent when nothing was adopted.

fields.name: keystateSerial
fields.description: Serial of the current key state document.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: Every source tried, in order.

fields.name: link
fields.description: The flare-recover:// deep link or QR code content, verbatim.

models.name: AccessRecoveryImport
models.description: Result of importing a recovery link.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: adopted, unchanged (this link was already imported) or rejected.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Why a link was rejected: a code of AccessRefreshAttempt.code or developmentMode. Commonly rollback (the link is older than this device's manifest) or badSignature.

fields.name: serial
fields.description: Directory serial after the import.

models.name: AccessPointInfo
models.description: One access point of the home cell with its health on the current network.

fields.name: accessPointId
fields.description: Access point id.

fields.name: regionId
fields.description: Region the access point is in.

fields.name: host
fields.description: Host name shown on the diagnostics page.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Manifest status: active, draining, disabled or unknown.

fields.name: rttMs
fields.description: Smoothed round trip on the current network, when measured.

fields.name: breaker
fields.description: Circuit breaker state: closed, open or halfOpen.

fields.name: protocolWinner
fields.description: Protocol that last won the race on this network: quic or ws.

fields.name: pinned
fields.description: Whether this access point is manually pinned.

fields.name: current
fields.description: Whether the IM connection is on this access point.

models.name: AccessEndpoint
models.description: One side of an access point switch.

fields.name: ap
fields.description: Access point id.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Transport: quic or ws.

models.name: AccessSwitchedEvent
models.description: Payload of access://switched: the IM connection moved to another access point (sent once, when the new connection is ready).

fields.name: from
fields.description: Where the connection was.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Where the connection is now.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why: failure, drain, failback, manual or manifest.

models.name: AccessChanges
models.description: What a newly accepted access manifest changed.

fields.name: accessPointsAdded
fields.description: Access points that appeared.

fields.name: accessPointsRemoved
fields.description: Access points that disappeared.

fields.name: policyChanged
fields.description: Whether the client link policy changed.

models.name: AccessChangedEvent
models.description: Payload of access://changed: a new access manifest was accepted. Sent for every adoption; a periodic re-signature has empty changes.

fields.name: serial
fields.description: Serial of the accepted manifest.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where it came from, in the form of AccessStatus.source.

fields.name: stale
fields.description: Whether it is past its expiry.

fields.name: developmentMode
fields.description: Endpoints come from development-mode configuration.

fields.name: changes
fields.description: What changed against the previous manifest.
